verdict.rationale: Airwallex is a financial platform that acts as an MCP server provider: the AgentOS MCP at mcp.airwallex.com and the Developer/Docs MCP let external agents call Airwallex. Plugging third-party MCP servers into a product so it can use their tools is the agent or MCP-client role, which is a category error for a payments and treasury platform. Nothing in the evidence shows Airwallex hosting an agent that consumes external MCP servers, and its server-side MCP offerings belong to a different story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
